LUX

~ a small economy of light ~
fly — Lux follows your pointer or finger
gather — linger in lamplight to collect dust
bank — carry it home to the jar before something bites you
beware — lamps you bleed dry go dark, and dark lamps set their bats loose
travel — fly into the chalk circles at the edges
shop — spacebar or the button below opens the upgrade shop
challenge — ring the bell in the last area, if you dare

THE MOON, ACQUIRED

The owl concedes. Lux is now rich beyond all reason. Every lamp on earth answers to her. The bats send apologies. The mantis sends a card.

It was never about the light. But the light was nice.
